searchUrls.title: Dice search URLs
searchUrls.description: Search pages copied from dice.com/jobs with any filters set on the site (location, posted date, employment type, remote, easy apply...). Each URL is one search.

queries.title: Keywords
queries.description: Or build searches here. One search per keyword, e.g. python developer, data engineer, "site reliability".

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional. City, state or ZIP, e.g. Austin, TX or 10001. Empty searches all of the US.

postedWithin.title: Posted within
postedWithin.description: Only jobs posted in this window.

employmentTypes.title: Employment type
employmentTypes.description: Any of these. Empty means all.

workplaceTypes.title: Workplace
workplaceTypes.description: Any of these. Empty means all.

employerType.title: Employer type
employerType.description: Direct hire is the company itself; recruiter is an agency.

easyApplyOnly.title: Easy apply only
easyApplyOnly.description: Only jobs you can apply to on Dice in one click.

sponsorshipOnly.title: Willing to sponsor only
sponsorshipOnly.description: Only jobs whose employer will sponsor a work visa.

includeDetails.title: Full description and skills
includeDetails.description: Opens each job for its full description, skills list, ZIP code and expiry date. Slower. $0.002 per job instead of $0.001.

maxItemsPerSearch.title: Max jobs per search
maxItemsPerSearch.description: Dice returns up to 10,000 jobs per search. Narrow by location or posted date for more.
